name: AI Deep Dive — APLD — 2026-05-02
rationale: APLD is an AI infrastructure and data center play growing at 139% YoY, but trading at an extreme 66x Price-to-Sales multiple ($9.5B market cap on $144M revenue). The market is pricing in flawless execution of their multi-gigawatt pipeline and SaaS-like terminal margins. However, data center hosting is capital intensive and highly competitive. My weighted fair value of $15 indicates significant downside risk as the hype cycle normalizes.

aiThesis.rationale: Applied Digital (APLD) is riding the AI infrastructure super-cycle, securing massive leases (like CoreWeave). However, a $9.5B valuation on $144M in trailing revenue requires the company to execute perfectly for the next decade. Data centers are capital-heavy (APLD burned $797M in FCF last year), which will likely necessitate further severe shareholder dilution. Even in a bullish scenario where they reach $3.5B in revenue by Year 5 with 25% net margins, the current price offers very little margin of safety.
